note: Field contract for one detector replay, fixed before any result exists. The pending KAIROS runner writes one JSON object per run; scripts/aggregate_results.py refuses records that do not satisfy this contract. Adding a field is allowed; removing or redefining one is a design change and belongs in the EXPERIMENT_DESIGN change log.

optional_fields.processed_dates: list of the dates whose graphs this run actually loaded

value_rules.seed: null only when pattern is baseline
value_rules.mask_sha256: null only when pattern is baseline
value_rules.total_label_nodes: Fixed per case on the complete no-loss input; identical across every run of that case.

retention: Failed runs are recorded with exit_status "failed" and kept. They are excluded from metric averages and reported separately.
comparability: PIDSMaker silently skips a test date whose graphs are absent, so a missing input weakens the evaluation without raising an error. Record processed_dates and graph_file_count on every run and confirm they are identical across the baseline and every loss variant of a case before comparing results.
